turns.text: Great, let's get started. Could you tell me a little about your job, Josh? Okay, let's go over the plan for today. Hello, and welcome to your English lesson! We'll practice talking about your work and the projects you're involved in. We'll cover two grammar points: the present perfect for your experience, and the past simple for finished events at a specific time. You'll also practice follow-up questions, I'll correct your mistakes and give you a chance to try again, and near the end you can practice your pronunciation if you like. Before we begin, there's a short one-time level check so I can adjust the lesson for you. Could you tell me a little about your job, Josh?
I am a manager at a communications company in Japan.
Thanks, Josh. That is a clear answer. Have you ever worked with an international customer? If so, can you tell me about the experience?
Yes, I work with companies in Japan and worldwide.

Thanks, Josh. You told me you work with companies in Japan and worldwide. Can you tell me about one specific experience with an international customer? 「どんな経験があったか」を具体的に教えてください。 What is one skill you'd like to improve in your English, and why is it important to you?
I want better conversation with customers before meetings.

Good, that is a clear goal. Your goal is clear. Can you say the reason in a full sentence, like 'It is important because...'? Use 'want to improve' with a skill. 'Better conversation' is unnatural here. 「会話を改善したい」は、英語では want to improve my conversation と言います。 Let's move on to your job. Tell me about your main responsibilities at work, in two sentences.
Okay, please stop. I would like to end the session for now.
Understood, Josh. 今日は会話の練習ができましたね。 お疲れさまでした。 Today we practised describing your job and your work with international customers. Thank you, Josh, and goodbye!
Can we continue from this point next time?
Yes, we can pick up from here next time. 次回も、今日の続きから始めましょう。 What is one work project you would like to talk about next time?
Sorry, I have to finish now.
Understood, Josh. 今日は仕事の話を練習しましたね。 お疲れさまでした。 Thanks for practising today, Josh. Goodbye, and see you next time!
